nodes.title: Differential-thrust mixing in fixed-wing flight
nodes.text: Per-motor output = throttle + roll_factor * rudder_dt * 0.5 with Quad-X roll factors normalised to +/-0.5, so full rudder moves each motor by 0.25 x RUDD_DT_GAIN/100
nodes.basis: SRC-F4-AP-SRC AP_MotorsMulticopter::output_motor_mask and AP_MotorsMatrix::normalise_rpy_factors

nodes.title: ArduPlane source at tag Plane-4.7.2: VTOL_Assist.cpp, tailsitter.cpp, quadplane.cpp, mode_rtl.cpp, mode_qrtl.cpp, mode_LoiterAltQLand.cpp, events.cpp, fence.cpp; AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp; AC_AttitudeControl.cpp
nodes.note: should_assist(): Q_ASSIST_ALT <= 0 and Q_ASSIST_ANGLE <= 0 disable those triggers; angle assist needs attitude outside the FW limits + 5 deg AND error > Q_ASSIST_ANGLE for Q_ASSIST_DELAY. Tailsitter output(): FW throttle -> output_motor_mask() (pass-through); with Q_OPTIONS bit 8 the surfaces stay on the plane controllers in assist. setup(): tailsitter defaults table only for Q_FRAME_CLASS 10. ModeRTL::_enter(): QRTL only within 1.5 x max(WP_LOITER_RAD, RTL_RADIUS) and below Q_RTL_ALT. ModeLoiterAltQLand::_enter(): VTOL -> QLAND. Q_A_ANGLE_BOOST default 1; Q_TRANSITION_MS default 5000

nodes.title: Fixed-wing motor output is pass-through (no Q_M_SPIN_MAX, no thrust curve)
nodes.text: In fixed-wing flight Tailsitter::output() takes throttle = k_throttle/100 and calls output_motor_mask(), where actuator = throttle + roll_factor x rudder_dt x 0.5 and PWM = min + range x actuator. Settled from source (F4-R8; was 'higher of pass-through or linearised')
